text.tspan: Interpersonal trust measured in different surveys
Share of respondents agreeing with the statement "Most people can be trusted", across two different survey
Data source: Integrated Values Survey (2024) and other sources
Note: For each country, the shown survey observations correspond to the latest survey wave available in the period 2010-2022. Where a
country or region lacks data for the year shown, the closest available value within 15 years is shown instead.
